modern: Consider what condition, both in body and soul, a man should be in when he is overtaken by death; and consider the shortness of life, the boundless abyss of time past and future, the feebleness of all matter.

explained.summary: A note to himself with three things to think about: what state of body and mind you’d want to be in when death arrives, how short life is against the vast stretch of time on either side, and how fragile everything material is. Each thought shrinks petty concerns down to size.
